trial_court: Court of Additional District & Sessions Judge, Bansur, District Alwar
case_name: Smt. Deepika W/O Lokesh Pareek D/O ... vs Lokesh Pareek S/O Malaram Pareek

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Smt. Deepika W/O Lokesh Pareek D/O ... (wife)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Parties entered into marriage on 19.02.2011. Respondent-husband filed application under Section 9 of Hindu Marriage Act, 1955. Applicant-wife seeks transfer to Family Court, Jhunjhunu.

legal_principles.principle: Transfer of application for restitution of conjugal rights should be to the place where the wife is residing at least at the time of presentation of the application.
legal_principles.held: Looking to the nature of application filed by the respondent-husband particularly for restitution of conjugal rights, this Court is of opinion that the same may be transferred at the place where wife is residing at least at the time of presentation of this application.

legal_principles.principle: The Family Court has jurisdiction to entertain an application for restitution of conjugal rights.
legal_principles.held: Moreover, the Family Court, Jhunjhunu is also having jurisdiction to entertain

outcome.final_order: Application transferred to Family Court, Jhunjhunu.

keywords: Protection of Women from DV Act
